title: arabis muralis var. saxigena
intro: Arabis muralis var. saxigena, commonly known as rock cress, is a plant species belonging to the Brassicaceae family. It is a perennial herb that has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering a range of health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which can help to alleviate symptoms of various ailments. The therapeutic actions of rock cress include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit spasmolytic properties, and act as a diuretic. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic properties include isothiocyanates, which have been shown to possess anti-cancer and anti-inflammatory activities.
